subject: George Karani
tagline: Physical AI • Embodied Intelligence • Autonomous Systems

lobes.name: Physical AI & Embodied Reflexes

mood.expressionLabel: Brow locked, eyes narrowed, jaw set
mood.thought: Autoregression is too slow for physics. If you can't react in 10ms, you slip.
thoughts: Autoregression is too slow for physics. If you can't react in 10ms, you slip.
The first 15 tasks were obedient. Then the wrist rotated and every token I'd trained became a lie.
A grasp that looks clean on a replay is just physics you got lucky with.

lobes.description: Exploration of reflexive, low-latency intelligence. Moving beyond slow autoregressive text tokens toward motor memory and contact physics.

nodes.title: Muscle Memory (UniBot-V1)
nodes.subtitle: Looped-Transformer Instinct Layer
nodes.content: Multi-task behavioral cloning policy utilizing a recurrent looped-transformer architecture for sub-10ms reactive manipulation and contact-verified grasping.

mood.expressionLabel: Tight smile held back by concentration
mood.thought: 32 tasks. 17 solved. I still think about the other 15 every time I open the eval script.
thoughts: 32 tasks. 17 solved. I still think about the other 15 every time I open the eval script.
Zero-slip contact verification was the only metric that actually meant anything.
Telling a robot to 'be careful' is not an instruction. Hertz is.
notes: the 15 unsolved tasks won't leave me alone

nodes.title: Fast & Curious
nodes.subtitle: JSAE Autonomous Driving AI Challenge
nodes.content: Model Predictive Control (MPC) tracking modules, ROS 2 sensor fusion (IMU/GNSS/LiDAR), and autonomous stuck-recovery supervisor for high-speed racing karts.

mood.thought: Every controller that worked on the simulator betrayed me at corner three.
thoughts: Every controller that worked on the simulator betrayed me at corner three.
I built a stuck-recovery supervisor because ego has to be embarrassed into continuing.
The kart doesn't know it is racing. That's why it is faster than me.
notes: corner three is always where it breaks

lobes.name: Silicon & Low-Level Edge

mood.expressionLabel: Chin down, eyes scanning, lips parted
mood.thought: When the compiler gives up, you have to go down to the silicon gates.
thoughts: When the compiler gives up, you have to go down to the silicon gates.
A hazard is just a story the pipeline tells itself about the future.
Hades-V taught me that forwarding units are just arguments.
notes: what if it just ran here

lobes.description: Hardware-software co-design, custom processor microarchitecture, and on-device offline inference.

nodes.title: Hades-V
nodes.subtitle: 32-bit Pipelined RISC-V Processor
nodes.content: From-scratch pipelined RISC-V processor implementing architectural hazard handling, forwarding units, and low-level execution efficiency.

mood.expressionLabel: Still, patient, one brow slightly raised
mood.thought: Writing it in SystemVerilog made me slow down in a way I needed to.
thoughts: Writing it in SystemVerilog made me slow down in a way I needed to.
You cannot bluff a hazard unit. The waveform knows.
Slow to write, faster forever after.
notes: writing my own ISA shows what vendor docs hide

nodes.title: Mobile Edge Assistant (MEA)
nodes.subtitle: On-Device Micro-Agents
nodes.content: Sub-3B micro-LLMs executing deterministic tool calling entirely on-device on commodity smartphones.

mood.thought: If my agent needs a round trip to know what a calendar is, it isn't mine.
thoughts: If my agent needs a round trip to know what a calendar is, it isn't mine.
Sub-3B and no egress. That's the whole thesis, and it's a boring-sounding one.
Latency is a privacy feature nobody markets.
notes: zero egress or it isn't mine
whisper.cpp on a mid-range phone — surprisingly fine

nodes.title: Greta Productivity Engine
nodes.subtitle: Native Linux Daemon & Local Analytics
nodes.content: Native Rust engine tracking xprop window states and telemetry with zero cloud dependency.

mood.thought: I know what every window on my machine is doing. That feels less like surveillance and more like breathing.
thoughts: I know what every window on my machine is doing. That feels less like surveillance and more like breathing.
Rust because I wanted the daemon to be the quietest thing in the room.
No telemetry leaves. Ever. That's the whole feature.
notes: no cloud, no telemetry, no apology

nodes.title: Racing Dynamics & Trajectory Lines
nodes.subtitle: Apex Control & Physical Limits
nodes.content: Understanding real-world friction, tire grip limits, and the visceral feel of vehicle dynamics translates directly into tuning MPC controllers.

mood.thought: Grip limits don't care what the model predicted. Neither should my controller.
thoughts: Grip limits don't care what the model predicted. Neither should my controller.

tuning the controller against the kerb
